mission.title: The Dynamic
mission.description: Standard maintenance covers material wear and electrical faults. But 48% of failures in modern hydropower are dynamic—vibration, cavitation, and resonance that traditional audits miss.
mission.issue1Desc: Micro-arcing in bearings (EDM) goes undetected until seizure.
mission.issue2Desc: Structural frequencies shift over decades, creating silent fatigue.
mission.solution Desc: We developed the AnoHUB Protocol—a rigid, multi-tiered methodology that enforces 0.05mm precision and eliminates the "Organizational Execution Gap".
